column2: About time for the $$アブラナ$$ flowers to bloom...
We'll have to pick a whole batch soon, enough to make a year's supply of oil!
Hey! Those $$ひまわり$$ seeds we planted in the garden are about to bloom! Did you notice?
Speaking of which, have you ever seen the red flowers of $$ベルガモット$$?
Dry those flowers and you can make $$ハーブティー$$ from them...!
About time for the $$サフラン$$ to bloom.
If we're gonna brighten up our everyday meals, we've gotta pay attention to the $$調味料$$ too!
Morning! Well? How are you feeling?
Nice breezy morning... Let's work hard at your $$リハビリ$$ today too!
Morning! All right, let's give it our all from first thing today!!
Morning! Looks like it'll get hot again today!
It's finally getting comfortable outside...
If we dawdle, winter'll be here before we know it!!
Morning. It'll get cold soon, so let's start preparing for winter!
Morning! Feels like it might snow today... Kinda exciting!
If winter comes, can spring be far behind? Spring's just around the corner!
Good work... It's hot again today!
On a day this hot... let's have a $$水鉄砲$$!!
Have a $$水鉄砲$$!
Don't have a $$水鉄砲$$!
Yeah, you're right!
You're still in the middle of $$リハビリ$$... Sorry!
A $$台風$$! Let's fix that roof leak, quick!!
Sorry!
I made you overdo it when you're still recovering...
But... I'm glad you're here!
If I were alone, I'd still be freezing...
No, I'm not cold! Are you holding up okay?
Just being with you makes me feel warm deep inside...
I want us to stay together... forever...
Pant... pant... S-sorry...!
I-it's only a bit of a fever.
Thanks for yesterday...!
You stayed with me all night, didn't you...
I seriously thought I was gonna die yesterday...
Thanks for yesterday...
B-but... don't go off somewhere alone again, got it?!
Heh! Remember what day it is?!
Ta-daaaaa!!
Here! Happy $$誕生日$$!!
I tried making something with a completely new $$レシピ$$—something I've never made before!
So... what do you think?
Will you taste it...?!
Pant... pant... it hurts... but I'm glad you're safe...
Pant... pant...
I-it's nothing...
$$ゼロ$$ is gone!!
A-are you okay?!
You've only been awake for a week...!
But don't push yourself. You don't look back to normal yet!
And... there's one thing I need to tell you!
This is important, so don't ever forget it!!
You've lost your $$記憶$$ of this $$世界$$...
so you can't be used to how things work in this $$世界$$ yet!
So until I can feel safe letting you leave the house,
I don't want you going outside the fence on your own!!
Got it? You absolutely cannot go outside!!
For now... let's keep working hard at your $$リハビリ$$!!
Hey, you...!
Do you remember what day it is?!
